title: Continuous Curved 2D Spiral Manifold (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `vector_spiral` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Tests continuous curved probability mass (1.5-turn Archimedes spiral with radial noise sigma=0.08) rather than a finite table of point clusters, checking global sliced W1, mean, and covariance fidelity.
failure_mode: Overly rigid discrete prototype charts quantize the smooth spiral into beads or cut straight chords across inner turns.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `vector_spiral` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
